mintAuthority.summary: AUDD is issued by AUDC Pty Ltd (Novatti, AFSL 700123); minting and 1:1 AUD redemption run through the issuer's centralized backend against segregated AUD cash and Treasury bills at Australian ADIs.

controls.label: AUDC Pty Ltd issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated mint/redeem: AUDC Pty Ltd creates and redeems AUDD supply 1:1 against custodied AUD reserves; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists across its native multichain deployments.

controls.label: AUDD Stellar issuer (3-of-7 multisig)
controls.evidence: Stellar Horizon confirmed: issuer account GDC7X2MX... has master key weight 0 (locked), 7 co-signers each weight 1, and low/med/high thresholds all = 3. Effective authority is a 3-of-7 multisig. Asset is AUDD issued by this account.

controls.label: AUDD XRPL issuer (master key disabled — account locked)
controls.evidence: XRPL account_info confirmed: AccountFlags 9437184 = 0x900000 (lsfDefaultRipple=true, lsfDisableMaster=true). No RegularKey field. No SignerList (account_objects returned empty). The issuer account's master key is disabled and no signing authority exists — the XRPL AUDD issuer account is locked and cannot mint new tokens or modify balances on XRPL.

controls.label: AUDD Hedera token admin key

KYC key is null. The supply_key controls minting; all control keys are the same single key held by the issuer backend.

review.evidence: AUDD whitepaper and transparency materials describe a single regulated issuer (AUDC Pty Ltd / Novatti) minting against off-chain AUD reserves with William Buck attestations. All addressable mint surfaces confirmed: Ethereum (owner EOA 0x59a5..., proxy admin EOA 0x840b...) and Base (owner EOA 0xa375..., proxy admin EOA 0x31c9...) via EIP-1967 reads. Stellar (3-of-7 multisig, master key weight 0). XRPL (single master key, no SignerList). Solana SPL mintAuthority = EOA CnwUo... Hedera supply_key = issuer protobuf key. XDC owner = EOA 0x994a... Redbelly uses same contract structure as Ethereum (not independently queried, note-only). Multiple distinct EOA owners per chain is consistent with per-chain issuer key management for a centralized fiat-backed issuer. William Buck performs monthly independent agreed-upon procedures; the latest reviewed report covers June 30, 2026, was published July 6, 2026, and fully reconciles AUDD liabilities to reserve accounts. ASIC's professional register and AUDC's terms match AFSL 700123 to AUDC Pty Ltd, but an AFSL is conduct authorization rather than APRA prudential supervision and AUDC is not an APRA-authorized deposit-taking institution. Supervision is therefore attestation-only.
